verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas or a data dictionary for a machine channel, so this axis applies. The evidence pack holds only HTTP 403 responses at the robots.txt files of mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, with no evidence that any machine-readable specification is published. Confidence is medium rather than high because the walls blocked any further inspection, not because a spec was shown to be absent.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary
